profile_name: Chihuahua AI Lab / approved demo-led Reels
selection: Use only when the user names 치와와 AI Lab or chihuahua_ai.lab, or explicitly selects this account profile
audience: 최신 AI 소식을 알고 싶은 일반 독자

brand.accent_role: small brand mark, scene number and active scene progress
brand.avoid: large orange backgrounds or an orange tint over photography

visual_layout.photography: fallback only: relevant fixed real photograph, without ornamental panning or zooming
visual_layout.information: large unboxed Korean headline and short stable explanation matched to the visible demonstration

ui_calibration.reference: 2026-10-17 user-provided capture of the previous uploaded editorial Reel
ui_calibration.status: User approved expanded layout for future production; the new video has been locally reviewed, not verified through a new Instagram upload
ui_calibration.rule: Use lower space above account controls, keep clear of the right rail, and recalibrate against the latest capture rather than treating these margins as universal
ui_calibration.supersedes: Older important-content cutoff at logical y=1440

visual_layout.demonstration: large actual product demo, official sample or relevant licensed moving footage; preserve geometry and original visual detail

motion_policy.primary_motion: Actual source footage and meaningful changes in the demonstration carry the motion
motion_policy.information: One visible action or useful fact per scene; keep explanatory copy stable while read
motion_policy.transitions: Cut at a meaningful change of subject or use a soft handoff; avoid rapid unrelated cuts
reject: small demonstration thumbnails beneath oversized decoration
moving a still photograph merely to add motion
motion_policy.review: Watch the full final encoded MP4 at phone size and 1x; compare early, middle and late states per chapter and review local recompression variants
motion_policy.reference_treatment: 2026-10-25 Lemo-Opuscar Reel: large actual demo excerpts, short Korean copy, practical prompt and segmented progress
motion_policy.supersedes: The 2026-10-23 fixed-photo staged editorial treatment as the default for future Reels; keep it as an optional fallback

acknowledgement: 이 결과물은 가짜연구소(Pseudo Lab) No-More-Slops 그룹 활동의 일환으로 제작되었습니다.
news_policy: Verify a fresh official source for each new edition; preserve source dates and separate announced plans from releases
scope: Future Reels for this named account; does not authorize publishing or impose a scene count

content_policy.audience: 새 AI 도구를 직접 써보고 싶은 일반 독자
content_policy.selection: 주제를 새로 고를 때는 현재 이용할 수 있는 서비스나 기능에 실제 활용 예시를 붙일 수 있는 소식을 우선 선택
content_policy.example: 익숙한 작업 하나, 공식 서비스 주소, 실제 시작 위치와 입력 방법, 복사해서 쓸 전체 프롬프트 또는 단계별 사용 방법
content_policy.conditions: 요금제, 연령과 순차 제공 등 사용에 필요한 조건을 해당 예시와 함께 표시
content_policy.evidence: 직접 작성한 프롬프트, 공식 시연 화면, 실제 테스트 결과를 구분하며 요청값을 측정값으로 쓰지 않음
content_policy.scope: Future news for this named account; an explicit requested topic or different audience overrides this preference

freshness.date_basis: original feature or service announcement, separately from edition date
freshness.rule: 새 소식을 요청받으면 실제 신규 출시나 기능 변경을 확인하고, 기존 기능의 활용 팁을 신규 출시로 선정하지 않음
freshness.override: 사용자가 지정한 기간이나 소재를 우선 적용
